The CASTLE
Old world character, family hospitality and a stone s throw from Galway City.
Cloonacauneen Castle is a 15th century castle on the outskirts of Galway City. We are surrounded by countryside but very easy to reach from the city and the main routes into Galway.
‍
The castle carries five centuries of history. We are a family-run business, meaning you will get warm hospitality, old stories and a personal experience. It s full of charm, lived-in, and genuinely unlike anywhere else in Galway.
‍
Whether you re here for a wedding, Sunday lunch or a night away  you ll leave with the feeling that the setting made it.
